crossRefs.note: That same day, Yahweh brought the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt by their armies.

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: That same day, Yahweh brought the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt by their armies.
translations.bsb: And on that very day the LORD brought the Israelites out of the land of Egypt by their divisions.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass the selfsame day, that the LORD did bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt by their armies.
translations.asv: And it came to pass the selfsame day, that Jehovah did bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt by their hosts.
